explication: TDS CarPlay is an iOS app for viewing video and mirroring a device screen on a CarPlay display; the README cautions against use while driving. The main product flows are video playback through browser/player UI and screen capture through ReplayKit, with AirPlay reception and CarPlay controls as related capabilities. The tree also indicates settings, camera roll, payments, help, and service/API features. Sampled code confirms broadcast networking, screen-frame handling, AirPlay receiver attachment, and share-extension handoff; wiring for several other listed features is not shown, so those links are omitted.
